heroHeading: Specialist Flat & High-Rise Removals in Birmingham & Beyond
heroSubheading: Specialist flat removals in Birmingham for city-centre apartments, high-rises and walk-up conversions, including the Jewellery Quarter and Digbeth. We book lift slots, arrange loading bays and protect communal hallways, stairs and lifts throughout your move.
summary: Relocating between apartments or high-rise flats requires experienced local movers who understand lift bookings, tight corridors, and parking restrictions. Our professional removal company protects communal hallways and stairs with floor runners while carefully manoeuvring bulky sofas, mattresses, and appliances. Whether you are moving house into a city-centre development or a suburban walk-up in Solihull, we provide prompt, fully insured flat removals with guaranteed fixed pricing from day one.
benefits: Expert navigation of tight residential loading bays and restricted parking
Coordination with building concierges and building management lift slots
Specialist narrow-access equipment and furniture protection
Rapid loading and unloading to respect timed building access windows

process.title: Access & Lift Assessment
process.description: We establish building access protocols: service lift dimensions, parking loading bays, access codes, and designated move-in time windows.

process.title: Communal Area Protection
process.description: We lay floor protectors and pad internal doorways to ensure communal hallways and lifts remain completely undamaged during transit.

process.title: Timed Staged Loading
process.description: Our team works efficiently to load the removal van within your booked service lift slot, reducing disruption to fellow residents.

process.title: Direct Delivery to New Flat
process.description: We transport your goods directly to your new flat, carrying items up to your floor and assembling beds or tables as requested.

faqs.question: What if our apartment building does not have a lift?
faqs.answer: We frequently handle stair-only flats across Victorian conversions and walk-up blocks. Please let us know the floor number and staircase width when requesting a quote so we can allocate appropriate crew members for safe lifting.

faqs.question: Can you comply with strict 2-hour goods lift slots?
faqs.answer: Yes. When building management specifies a rigid lift slot, we arrive early, prep and stage items beforehand, and execute the lift transfer with disciplined speed.

faqs.question: Do I need to arrange parking permits outside my flat?
faqs.answer: If your apartment building has a designated loading bay, please inform concierge in advance. For street parking with permit restrictions, reserving space or notifying neighbours ensures safe van positioning.

faqs.question: Can you dismantle large sofas that won't fit the lift?
faqs.answer: Where sofas have removable bolt-on arms or modular sectional feet, we can safely dismantle them for transport and reassemble them inside your apartment.
